title: Can a Vercel Eve agent turn a GitHub issue into a draft PR as well as the Railway worker?
hypothesis: An Eve agent on Vercel completes the same 5 issue-to-draft-PR jobs as the Railway worker at comparable cost, with less operational work for us.
human_gate: Frank defines 'software factory' and approves any Vercel project creation.

runs_on.why: Eve is built to run on Vercel Sandboxes and Workflows.

success_rule: Eve matches the incumbent on accepted PRs and its setup plus operating hours are lower.
kill: Stop at $5 of Token Pass or if Eve cannot spend a Token Pass key (OIDC cannot), which would be a result.
decision_it_feeds: Whether the factory runs on Vercel Eve, Railway, or both.
